provenance.sourceProductName: Viking MDIM2.1 colorized global mosaic 1 km JPEG
provenance.attribution: USGS Astrogeology, Mars Viking Colorized Global Mosaic 232m and 1km ancillary JPEG
provenance.operations: Source RGB decode; coordinate-aware bilinear resampling; 1024-pixel JPEG tiles at quality 87; SHA-256 each tile
provenance.note: The 1km JPEG has about 59 pixels/degree. Fine brightness structure incorporates higher-resolution monochrome Viking data; color itself is lower-resolution and baked illumination remains. PAM geotransform (-10670000,5335000; 1000,-1000 m) is explicitly reprojected to the planetocentric east-positive runtime grid.

provenance.sourceOrganization: NASA GSFC Scientific Visualization Studio / LROC
provenance.sourceProductName: CGI Moon Kit 2019 full-resolution LROC WAC color mosaic
provenance.attribution: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit (4720), LROC WAC Hapke-normalized color mosaic
provenance.operations: Source RGB decode; coordinate-aware bilinear resampling; 1024-pixel JPEG tiles at quality 87; SHA-256 each tile
provenance.note: 76 ppd source is downsampled to 64 ppd in the same east-positive -180..180 frame as LOLA. Polar imagery above 70 degrees uses lower-resolution LOLA albedo fill; this is not full-resolution observed color there.

provenance.sourceProductName: Blue Marble Next Generation January 2004 unshaded base map, 2 km global JPEG
provenance.attribution: NASA Earth Observatory, Blue Marble: Next Generation; R. Stöckli et al.
provenance.operations: Source RGB decode; coordinate-aware bilinear resampling; 1024-pixel JPEG tiles at quality 87; SHA-256 each tile
provenance.note: Cloud-free visual color composite, not elevation. Source is geodetic equirectangular; output samples at the planetocentric latitude used by the Earth renderer. Native 60 ppd is bilinearly resampled to 64 ppd without claiming additional measured detail.
